_doc: Computer-player difficulty levels (src/ai/strategic_ai.gd, src/game/game_setup.gd). Each player has a difficulty (GameState player 'difficulty', set per slot in the new-game setup or a campaign chapter's setup.players[i].difficulty). order: the levels as the menus list them. default: the level of a slot that names none (and of saves before v9). Per level: name and description for the menus; income_percent scales a computer player's daily income from towns, mines and heroes (humans always get 100); ai: StrategicAI setting overrides. A game's rules.ai (a campaign chapter's 'ai') still applies on top of the level.

passive.name: Passive
passive.description: Builds and grows, but never goes after your heroes, towns or mines.

easy.name: Easy
easy.description: Cautious: fights only sure battles, keeps fewer heroes and earns a little less.

hard.name: Hard
hard.description: Aggressive: takes riskier battles, hunts your towns and heroes, keeps more heroes and earns a quarter more.

very_hard.name: Very hard
very_hard.description: Ruthless: weighs more battles before choosing, sees armies coming from further away, keeps up to five heroes and earns half again as much.
